hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '(^|/)sourceassets/' && { echo 'sourceassets/ must never be modified (see AGENTS.md).' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '(^|/)(package\.json|yarn\.lock)$' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"package.json and yarn.lock changes require user confirmation (see AGENTS.md)."}}'; exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])(yarn (add|remove|install|upgrade|up)|npm (install|i|uninstall|update)|pnpm (add|install|remove|update))([[:space:]]|$)' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Installing or changing packages modifies package.json/yarn.lock and requires user confirmation (see AGENTS.md)."}}'; exit 0

echo 'Reminder: the location (Philadelphia), time zone (America/New_York), and target resolution (1280x400) are fixed. Get user confirmation before changing anything displayed on screen or package.json/yarn.lock. Keep files under 200 lines, use spaces not tabs, and name files in src/components and src/lib after their default export.'
[ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = true ] && exit 0; out=$(yarn run check 2>&1) || { echo "yarn run check failed:" >&2; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
